Which pack is right for you?

Choose Pack of 1 if…

  • You have never used Youth Face Cream before.
  • You have sensitive skin and want to patch test first.
  • You want to try it before committing to a longer routine.

Choose Pack of 2 if…

  • You have already used one jar and your skin is comfortable with it.
  • You want to keep a spare so your routine doesn't stop between orders.
  • You are buying for yourself and one family member.

Choose Pack of 3 if…

  • You plan to follow the routine for a longer period.
  • You want the lowest price per jar.
  • Several people at home will use it.

How long does one 25g jar last?

It depends on how much you use and how often. The cream is meant to be applied in a small amount to the face and neck, mainly at night, so a 25g jar is designed to last for a stretch of regular use rather than a few days. Using more cream does not work faster and can irritate the skin.

Because skincare for dark spots and uneven tone is judged over several weeks of regular use, many people find it useful to have enough cream for that whole period. That is the main reason to choose Pack of 2 or 3 once you know the cream suits you.

Why not buy the biggest pack straight away?

Every skin is different. If you are new to creams with active ingredients like Kojic Acid and Alpha Arbutin, a single jar lets you patch test and see how your skin feels over the first weeks. If it suits you, a bigger pack lowers the cost from then on.
